prompt: A vertical 9:16 close-up photograph of an elderly woman's hand holding a glossy junk-mail flyer at chest height in a dim council-flat hallway, the cuff of her thick buttoned winter coat and the edge of a knitted glove pulled back at the wrist. Her hand is real and old: thin papery skin, liver spots, raised veins, a worn gold wedding ring, short unpainted nails. The flyer reads "SPONSOR A CHANCELLOR" in bold white sans-serif capitals, and under it is a photo of an invented well-fed man in his fifties in a navy cashmere coat, his face even sadder than a charity advert, eyes wet, lower lip unsteady, standing beside a gleaming car. Behind her hand, out of focus, a white uPVC door with a frosted glass panel lets in cold grey-blue dusk, and a warm amber light from another room catches one side of her knuckles. Normal lens, slightly off-centre, soft focus at the edges, low contrast and lifted blacks, like a noisy phone photo taken at night. Thanks.
